Use case: compositing.
Asset type: 1536x1024 landscape (3:2) portfolio project cover for Tysha, a baby-sleep audio app.
Input images: Images 1, 2 and 3 are supporting compositing inputs showing real Tysha interfaces inside phones. Image 4 is a layout-quality reference ONLY: a polished design portfolio composition with multiple screens on a softly lit color field.
Primary request: Extract the phone objects/UI portions from Images 1, 2, and 3 and compose three large iPhones into one beautiful premium project cover. Preserve the actual dark Tysha UI, its controls, icon positions, real labels and colors as faithfully as possible. Completely discard the app-store promotional copy and the tan rectangles outside each source phone. Use Image 1's main mix screen on the front center phone, Image 2's sounds library on the phone on the left/back, and Image 3's sleep timer on the phone on the right/back.
Composition: Three vertically upright front-facing iPhones, the center phone slightly larger and 40px lower, left and right slightly behind. Very subtle overlap of the outer edges of phones only, do not cover important UI controls. Balanced across the landscape frame; phones fill about 85% of the height with comfortable margins. Realistic silver charcoal phone rim, clean rounded corners, gentle dimensional depth, sharp legible screen contents. Keep phone screen proportions faithful.
Scene/backdrop: Restful warm copper and sand backdrop, sophisticated soft gradient, muted amber light blooming softly behind devices, grounded soft broad shadows and soft ambient studio lighting. Elegant calm minimalist product presentation.
Constraints: Preserve actual product UI from source inputs, including dynamic islands and black screens. No newly invented app interface, no generic dashboard. No text outside the phones. No logos outside the phones, no captions, no headers, no marketing copy, no buttons outside phones, no cursor circle, no View Project label, no browser chrome, no Codex toast, no webpage border from reference. Do not copy the automotive product or blue palette from Image 4. Deliver only one final landscape image.
